records.text: A YouTube commenter identified as Anna wrote that three of Jeffrey Epstein's four grandparents were born in Russia.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #2 (Ep 3QJqtW_NOSI)

appearances.snippet: Anna writes, your show is my favorite part of the day. I love what you do and what you stand for. Thank you. Also three out of four of Jeffrey Epstein's grandparents were born in Russia.

verification.notes: Genealogical reporting is inconsistent because records use historical Russian Empire borders while modern sources identify Lithuania, Belarus, and Germany. Reliable evidence located does not establish the exact count of three of four grandparents born in Russia.
